sources.title: altheavia/fun-matching · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Mocov3 for Matching Overview This is an experimental Mocov3 codebase for Matching. It keeps the tiny setup intentionally manageable so architecture changes can be inspected before a full training run.

sources.title: andrewclarksen/hw2-matching · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Mocov3 for Matching Overview This repository is a compact, custom PyTorch implementation of Mocov3 for Matching. The small configuration is intended for code review, smoke tests, and small controlled experiments rather than as a production-ready pretrained release.

sources.title: GitHub - facebookresearch/moco-v3: PyTorch implementation of MoCo v3 ...
sources.snippet: This is a PyTorch implementation of MoCo v3 for self-supervised ResNet and ViT. The original MoCo v3 was implemented in Tensorflow and run in TPUs. This repo re-implements in PyTorch and GPUs. Despite the library and numerical differences, this repo reproduces the results and observations in the paper.
